headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 15, 2026**
article:
The American League All-Stars dominated the National League All-Stars in the Midsummer Classic, securing a 4-0 victory. Miguel Vargas led the offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Kansas City Royals have transferred right-handed pitcher Nick Mears to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their team's availability. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed right-handed pitcher Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Texas Rangers have placed right-handed pitcher Chris Martin on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder impingement. The Cincinnati Reds have placed left-handed pitcher Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list due to a blister on his left index finger. The Miami Marlins have placed right-handed pitcher William Kempner on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain. The Atlanta Braves have placed left fielder Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Boston Red Sox have acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for a player to be named later. The Kansas City Royals have acquired right-handed pitcher Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles have acquired right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros.
